items.title: Solana’s “retired” validators still vote with 15% of active stake
items.summary: A November 14 cross-check found 31 program-retired identities still voting, while smaller validators’ ability to replace Foundation support remains unresolved.

items.title: OpenAI等五家AI公司遭起诉，要求叫停前沿AI研发
items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，据智通财经报道，美国四家非营利组织联合向旧金山高等法院提起诉讼，将OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、Meta以及SpaceX AI列为被告，要求法院叫停这些企业进一步开发最先进的人工智能模型。

items.title: BIT：加密总市值自10月初以来蒸发约8000亿美元，市场流动性承压
items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，据官方消息，BIT 独立分析师发文指出，自 10 月初以来，加密货币总市值已从 2.9 万亿美元降至 2.1 万亿美元，蒸发约 8000 亿美元。

items.title: BTC跌至6.2万美元，到底发生了什么？
items.summary: 原创 | Odaily 星球日报（@OdailyChina） 作者｜Azuma（@azuma_eth） 眼睛一睁，又是一场暴跌，又是一个新低……过去几天，这几乎成了加密货币投资者每天早上的固定体验。

items.title: 10月建仓959万美元UNI的某巨鲸卖出部分UNI，预计亏损154.6万美元

items.title: Aave高管：过去两天借款人共发生约3900万美元的清算
items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，据 The Defiant 报道，Aave 首席战略与业务官 Luigi D’Onorio DeMeo 发文表示，在过去两天内，借款人共发生了约 3900 万美元的清算。

items.title: 韩国加密交易所Coinone客服外包服务器遭入侵，部分用户咨询信息泄露
items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，韩国加密交易所 Coinone 发布公告称，其客户咨询业务外包商服务器于 11 月 12 日凌晨遭外部攻击者非法入侵，导致部分客户咨询相关个人信息泄露。

items.title: Aave Executive Reports $39 Million in Liquidations
items.summary: Luigi D'Onorio DeMeo reported about $18 million for one day and $21 million so far the next.

items.title: XRP Falls to 89 Cents on Coinbase, Its Lowest Since November 2024
items.summary: Coinbase recorded the low Saturday evening. XRP's seven-day and four-week losses exceeded bitcoin's and ether's over matching windows.

items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，据 Lookonchain 监测，交易员 0xc05b 在过去 10 小时内遭遇了 7 次爆仓，累计被清算了 172 枚 BTC（价值 1103 万美元）和 2984 枚 ETH（价值 544 万美元）。

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.summary: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

items.summary: Trackers linked 1.78 million SOL in stake withdrawals to the treasury company. The chain confirms the movements, but ownership remains disputed.

items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，据余烬监测，巨鲸 fiyopi 几天前以 2,207.5 美元的价格开多 2.45 万枚 ETH (约 5408 万美元)，随着 ETH 崩盘式下跌，该巨鲸在今天早上以 1,783.3 美元的价格认输平多，亏损 1049 万美元。

items.title: A forced Bitcoin Lightning exit can be cheap and still leave you waiting days
items.summary: The preprint's 2026 public force-close cohort paid a median 925 satoshis per channel, while the broadcaster's balance faced a 2.5-day median wait.

items.summary: PANews 11月15日消息，交易员 Flood 发文表示，BTC 出现其职业生涯中见过的最激进、最不敏感于价格的抛售行为，几乎所有抛售都发生在 Coinbase，而且发生在周末（流动性最差时段）。

items.title: Crypto Sheds $571 Billion in Ten Days as Losses Deepen
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether rebounded after another sharp drop, but matched 24-hour windows show the selloff accelerated from the Nov. 12 break below $72,000.

items.title: Bitcoin’s oil relief has a catch: more oil at sea, less on land
items.summary: The IEA raised its fourth-quarter supply forecast by 3.3 million barrels a day, while depleted land stocks and diesel shortages keep relief conditional.

items.summary: Officials said a router flooded the air-traffic network during maintenance, but had not determined whether faulty hardware or an installation error was responsible.

items.title: Binance Liquidations Near $800 Million as Bitcoin Sinks
items.summary: CoinGlass recorded $2.05 billion in liquidations across tracked exchanges, overwhelmingly in bets on rising prices.

items.summary: About 49.2 million KAVA was bridged to BNB Chain via LayerZero and sold for roughly $2.1 million in BNB and USDT.

items.summary: Crypto super PACs backed 78 candidates who have won seats in Congress. Just 13 of them will enter Congress for the first time.

items.title: Trump Nominates 4 SEC and CFTC Picks, Including CLARITY Act Negotiators
items.summary: The Senate Banking Committee has scheduled a hearing for SEC nominees Kristin Johnson and Steven Levine on November 19.

items.summary: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.
